findings.title: Customer expanding coaching benefit eligibility to senior ICs (program scoping, not a product change)
findings.description: Beatrix wants to extend the existing coaching benefit from department leads to the next layer of staff (senior individual contributors, many first-time dog owners on the new-puppy foundations track), citing burnout risk during crunch periods. This is a request to change who within Novak Studios is invited to use the existing product/benefit, not a request for new product functionality or a report of a defect. Tomás confirms this fits within current seat capacity (88% utilized) and offers to help draft an opt-in invitation, which is a services/messaging favor, not a product change.
findings.quote: I want to open it up to the next layer down — the senior individual contributors, a lot of them first-time dog owners on the new-puppy foundations track
findings.severity_reason: No product defect or missing capability; this is a customer-side program/rollout decision using existing product features.
findings.match_note: Not a product bug or feature gap — it's an internal eligibility/rollout decision by the customer, not present in the catalogue.

findings.title: Customer reports no app complaints / no issues reaching support
findings.description: Beatrix asks Hassan directly whether the app has been solid and whether any complaints have come through his team; Hassan confirms none have reached him and that things have been quiet on BetterBark. No defect, missing capability, or dissatisfaction is raised — this is an explicit confirmation that the product is working well for this account.
findings.quote: the app's been solid, right, Hassan? No complaints coming through your team?
findings.severity_reason: No issue exists; this exchange is a positive confirmation of product health, not a problem report.
findings.match_note: No underlying defect or feature gap is described, so there is nothing to match against the catalogue.
